run.decision: FAIL / NO_CANDIDATE_ADMITTED. The frozen 日K多资产007 three-role trend/risk allocator produced 6.744752% CAGR, 0.704081 Sharpe and 23.417924% MDD over the exact 2012-07-05 to 2026-08-20 common window with the user-specified 0.005% fee and zero primary slippage. The same-cost frozen V11 control produced 14.274693% CAGR, 1.652911 Sharpe and 7.393120% MDD, so 007 missed all three direct V11 comparison gates by wide margins. Its inverse-volatility and 10% portfolio-volatility budget did add risk-adjusted value versus the same-eligibility equal-weight control: Sharpe improved from 0.603621 to 0.704081 and MDD fell from 27.864248% to 23.417924%, although CAGR was slightly lower than the control's 6.939375%. Six of seven folds had positive Sharpe, but only two exceeded 1.00; the 2021-2022 fold failed severely at -8.882628% CAGR, -0.959697 Sharpe and 22.549914% MDD. At 0.05% adverse slippage per fill, CAGR remained 6.479474% but Sharpe was only 0.679037 and MDD 23.877259%. Target cadence, trade count, gross, cash, single-asset cap and regional-role integrity checks passed. The result shows that simple role diversification plus volatility sizing is better than equal-weight trend allocation but is not a substitute for V11's state routing, recovery, risk-contribution and NFCI de-risk-retention architecture. No 200/126/63 period, cadence, band, role, volatility target or cap rescue is allowed inside 007.

methodology.follow_up_policy: After any formal 007 metric is viewed, do not modify the role mapping, SMA/momentum/volatility periods, score, volatility floor, risk allocation, target volatility, single-asset cap, cadence, band, cost or window inside this trial. No weak region or fold may be removed. Any alternative is a separately preregistered trial and 007 remains in trial accounting.
pass_fail_gates: candidate full-window CAGR >= same-cost V11 CAGR
candidate full-window Sharpe >= same-cost V11 Sharpe
candidate full-window MDD <= same-cost V11 MDD
candidate CAGR >= CNY cash CAGR +5.00 percentage points, Sharpe >=1.00 and MDD <=15%
at least 6/7 fixed folds have Sharpe >0 and at least 4/7 have Sharpe >1.00
candidate 2020+ and 2022+ CAGR each exceed full-window CNY cash CAGR
with 0.05% adverse slippage per fill, CAGR >= CNY cash CAGR +3.00 percentage points and Sharpe >0.75
candidate target changes are 20-200 and executed trade count <=500
maximum gross <=100%, minimum target weight and cash >=0, maximum asset weight <=50%, and US/China regional-role violations =0
methodology.selection_metric: No candidate selection. One frozen candidate must beat same-cost V11 on CAGR and Sharpe without greater MDD and pass every absolute, fold, stress, turnover and constraint gate. Matched equal-weight, V11 and cash paths are controls only.

version.mechanism_text: A low-complexity three-role daily-close allocation that combines absolute trend eligibility, within-role risk-adjusted momentum, inverse-volatility diversification, a 10% portfolio-volatility target and cash should capture persistent gold/US/China risk premia with materially less noise than isolated trade triggers. allowed_changes: use one fixed daily-close candidate with exactly three roles: gold, one selected US index, and one selected China index
require previous close>SMA200 and positive 126-session return; rank within each role by 126-session return divided by max(63-session volatility,8%)
allocate selected roles by inverse max(63-session volatility,8%), cap one asset at 50%, and scale gross toward a fixed 10% forecast portfolio volatility without exceeding 100%
recompute every 20 common sessions, use a 10% hard rebalance band, decide on T-1 and execute on T close
compare against same-eligibility equal-role control, exact same-cost frozen V11, CNY cash, and 0.05% per-fill adverse-slippage stress
forbidden_changes: using execution-session close or later data to form the target executed on that session
testing alternative SMA, momentum or volatility lookbacks or combining multiple lookbacks
testing alternative 5/10/20/40-session cadence, band, volatility target, floor or asset cap
holding both Nasdaq and S&P 500 or both CSI300 and Shanghai Composite simultaneously
top-N selection across all five assets, optimized role weights or post-result region deletion
adding NFCI or any macro/fundamental factor to the candidate
adding stops, take-profit, maximum hold, leverage, financing, shorting or negative cash
changing V11 internals, point-in-time NFCI history or frozen decision-cost calendar
changing the user fee or hiding the preregistered slippage stress
promoting retrospective results as completed prospective evidence

shared_rules.execution: T close from T-1 or earlier daily-close information
